title: Markus images: clone gatsby-plugin-image (density breakpoints, AVIF/WebP/JPEG, blur placeholder, eager above the fold)
description:
Ryan 2026-10-03: Gatsby's image handling is far better than Papyrus's; clone how gatsby-plugin-image does it. Reference: live anth.us (verified build at /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-live/public; plugin source in Anth.us-live/node_modules/gatsby-plugin-image and gatsby-plugin-sharp).

Gaps vs Gatsby, as used by anth.us:
1. Breakpoints: Gatsby emits widths at 0.25x/0.5x/1x/2x of the layout's display width (e.g. 512/1024/2048) with sizes derived from the layout (e.g. '(min-width: 2048px) 2048px, 100vw'); Papyrus uses fixed 480/768/1024/1366, capped at 1366.
2. Formats: Gatsby serves AVIF, then WebP, then JPEG (for photos); Papyrus serves WebP, then the SOURCE format (photographic PNG: the reason for the 1366 cap and a ~300 MB artifact). AVIF is silently unavailable (local Pillow has no avif).
3. Placeholder: Gatsby inlines a tiny base64 blurred image and fades the real image in; Papyrus shows nothing.
4. Layout stability: Gatsby always reserves the aspect-ratio box; Papyrus has it only via the publication's ImagePipeline.wrap (Anth.us).
5. Loading: Gatsby loads above-the-fold images eagerly, the rest lazily.
Scope = what anth.us uses (YAGNI): match its placeholder type, layouts and formats; skip anything it doesn't use. Must keep Pilobol.us byte-identical unless it opts in.
